stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pyro, Blob and Avalanche wait for the Senate hearing as Mystique's gang, and Pyro teases old Blob about his manners. At the Capitol they stage a diversion, with Blob trying to flatten the X-Men while Pyro sets fires.
stages.whoA: Pyro: his fire throwing partner in Mystique's gang
stages.whoB: Blob: his huge, belching partner in Mystique's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pyro, Avalanche and Blob loot a market together, with Blob stuffing himself on fruit. Then they hit the X-Men outside Midtown Hospital, a brawl that is only a distraction for Mystique.
stages.whoA: Pyro: his fire throwing partner in Mystique's gang
stages.whoB: Blob: his huge, belching partner in Mystique's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pyro asks Avalanche, his old darling, to begin the diversion at the Senate hearing. Avalanche shakes the building while Pyro adds fire, and both battle the X-Men at the Capitol.
stages.whoA: Pyro: his fire wielding partner in Mystique's gang
stages.whoB: Avalanche: his earthquake making partner in Mystique's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pyro praises Avalanche's work as they raid a market with Blob. Later the two ambush the X-Men at Midtown Hospital to keep them busy while Mystique goes after Rogue.
stages.whoA: Pyro: his fire wielding partner in Mystique's gang
stages.whoB: Avalanche: his earthquake making partner in Mystique's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Avalanche and Blob join Pyro in Mystique's plot at the Senate hearing on mutants. Avalanche brings the house down while Blob tries to sit on the X-Men, until Storm freezes him.
stages.whoA: Blob: the huge, near unbreakable muscle of their gang
stages.whoB: Avalanche: his ground shaking partner in Mystique's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Avalanche and Blob rob a market with Pyro, then fight the X-Men outside Midtown Hospital. Blob shrugs off every hit as their brawl buys Mystique time to reach Rogue.
stages.whoA: Blob: the huge, near unbreakable muscle of their gang
stages.whoB: Avalanche: his ground shaking partner in Mystique's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Shani tells Storm that her son MjNari has changed, and that Storm became his second mother at his birth. When the Shadow King takes Shani, MjNari refuses to run, and once she is free she begs him to flee before the villain seizes him again.
stages.whoA: Shani: his mother in the village
stages.whoB: MjNari: her son, and Storm's godson

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sasquatch and Shaman help Alpha Flight trap Wolverine in the Canadian woods and bring him to Department H. When they learn General Chasen wants his skeleton, both join the team's raid to free him.
stages.whoA: Shaman: his Alpha Flight teammate, the medicine man
stages.whoB: Sasquatch: his huge, furry Alpha Flight teammate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sasquatch follows Vindicator as Alpha Flight hunts Wolverine down and hauls him to Department H. When Chasen's plan comes out, the team storms the lab, though Vindicator still tries to keep Wolverine.
stages.whoA: Vindicator: the leader of his Alpha Flight team
stages.whoB: Sasquatch: the strongman of his Alpha Flight team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Northstar and Sasquatch fight side by side as Alpha Flight captures Wolverine for Department H. Once they learn General Chasen plans to dissect him, both turn on Chasen to set him free.
stages.whoA: Sasquatch: his huge, furry Alpha Flight teammate
stages.whoB: Northstar: his speedy Alpha Flight teammate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Shaman tries to talk Wolverine down before Northstar snatches him into the air for Alpha Flight. Later both turn against General Chasen when they learn he means to cut Wolverine apart.
stages.whoA: Shaman: his Alpha Flight teammate, the medicine man
stages.whoB: Northstar: his speedy Alpha Flight teammate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Puck and Northstar help pin Wolverine down, with Puck telling him to listen to the Frenchies. Both later join Alpha Flight's raid on the lab once General Chasen's plan comes out.
stages.whoA: Puck: his short, tough Alpha Flight teammate
stages.whoB: Northstar: his speedy Alpha Flight teammate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Shaman blocks Wolverine's path as Vindicator leads Alpha Flight to bring him back, calling him a friend all the while. When Chasen's plan comes out, Shaman joins the raid as Vindicator tries to keep Wolverine.
stages.whoA: Vindicator: the leader of his Alpha Flight team
stages.whoB: Shaman: the medicine man of his Alpha Flight team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Puck and Sasquatch both take on Wolverine as Alpha Flight tries to bring him back to Department H. When General Chasen's plan comes out, they join the team's raid to free him.
stages.whoA: Sasquatch: his huge, furry Alpha Flight teammate
stages.whoB: Puck: his short, tough Alpha Flight teammate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Puck and Shaman join Alpha Flight's hunt for Wolverine and help hold him once he is down. They later turn on Department H with the team when they learn it wants his skeleton.
stages.whoA: Shaman: his Alpha Flight teammate, the medicine man
stages.whoB: Puck: his short, tough Alpha Flight teammate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: When Wolverine asks Vindicator what army will take him back, Puck answers as Alpha Flight arrives. Wolverine knocks him flat, and Puck later joins the revolt that frees Wolverine.
stages.whoA: Vindicator: the leader of his Alpha Flight team
stages.whoB: Puck: the tough little acrobat of his team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Heather and her husband Vindicator once nursed Wolverine back to health, and now both help Department H bring him in. When Heather quits to stop the dissection, Vindicator grabs her, and she begs Wolverine to spare her husband.
stages.whoA: Vindicator: her husband, James
stages.whoB: Heather: his wife

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: General Chasen has Alpha Flight, Sasquatch among them, bring Wolverine home, telling them he will rejoin the team. When they learn Chasen wants his skeleton, Sasquatch joins the raid on Chasen's lab and its android guards.
stages.whoA: Sasquatch: an Alpha Flight strongman who turns on him
stages.whoB: General Chasen: the Department H chief who lies to his team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: General Chasen has Northstar and Alpha Flight capture Wolverine, letting them believe he will rejoin the team. When they learn Chasen means to dissect him, Northstar turns on him and helps Wolverine escape.
stages.whoA: Northstar: an Alpha Flight speedster who turns on him
stages.whoB: General Chasen: the Department H chief who lies to his team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: General Chasen uses Shaman and Alpha Flight to track down Wolverine, and Shaman senses he is near. Learning that Chasen lied about Wolverine rejoining them, Shaman joins the team's raid on the lab.
stages.whoA: Shaman: Alpha Flight's medicine man, who turns on him
stages.whoB: General Chasen: the Department H chief who lies to his team

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Vindicator brings Wolverine in for General Chasen, believing Wolverine will rejoin Alpha Flight. When Chasen demands the skeleton, Vindicator holds Heather back and fights Wolverine, while Chasen orders the rest of his team subdued.
stages.whoA: Vindicator: the Alpha Flight leader who serves him
stages.whoB: General Chasen: his Department H commander

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In Logan's memories, Dr. Cornelius runs the adamantium feed while the Professor gives the orders. When Logan wakes in a rage, the Professor shouts at Cornelius to raise the sedative, but it is too late.
stages.whoA: The Professor: the man he answers to at the lab
stages.whoB: Dr. Cornelius: the scientist who runs his adamantium feed

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Spiral tells Mojo to go fetch the runaway Longshot himself, and Domo backs the sorceress's idea. He then reminds Mojo that they will need Spiral to cleave time and space for the trip.
stages.whoA: Spiral: the sorceress on Mojo's staff
stages.whoB: Domo: Mojo's deadpan right hand man

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ruckus and Vertigo both serve Sinister in the Savage Land, ambushing the powerless X-Men at their crashed jet. Ruckus taunts them to surrender while Vertigo makes Wolverine reel, but the X-Men win back their powers and the Nasty Boys flee.
stages.whoA: Vertigo: a dizzying fellow servant of Sinister
stages.whoB: Ruckus: a loud fellow servant of Sinister

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sinister calls Ruckus, Vertigo and Hairbag away after the Nasty Boys snatch Jean from her wedding. Later the pair fight the X-Men at the Axis of Time, until the psychics go free and Sinister's crew retreats.
stages.whoA: Vertigo: a dizzying fellow servant of Sinister
stages.whoB: Ruckus: a loud fellow servant of Sinister

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Barbarus and Brainchild ambush Xavier, Magneto and Ka-Zar in the secret passage to the citadel. Brainchild lets Ka-Zar run, content with the two prisoners they wanted. After the X-Men beat their master Sinister, the Mutates surrender.
stages.whoA: Brainchild: the big headed Mutate loyal to Sinister
stages.whoB: Barbarus: a four armed fellow Mutate

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Barbarus leads the Mutates against Magneto, his creator, while Vertigo overwhelms him and Xavier with her power. Together they haul the pair to their new master, Sinister, but after the X-Men beat him the Mutates surrender.
stages.whoA: Vertigo: a fellow Mutate who throws foes off balance
stages.whoB: Barbarus: a four armed fellow Mutate
